scope: Source-level batch adding a strict private solution-lifecycle gate-page response contract and pre-dispatch location UUID validation for Analytics and Credit Class CLI operations.

checks.command: ruff check on changed implementation and test files
python3 -m py_compile on changed implementation files

limitations: The response contract was exercised with mocked readers and ASGI; live OIDC and Gateway/database behavior remain unverified.
CLI UUID preflight and request-bound responses do not establish database row-level isolation or populated-data parity.
Capability classifications and MAN-CAP acceptance remain unchanged.
